scope: V7 generic blind/manual semantic protocol and the declared hierarchical index, selected attachment, exact quote, ID/container and format-error contract. Structural validation does not establish semantic relevance or content grades.
protocol_verdict: PASS: selectable level2–6 T/I units; level1 closure; explicit nonoverlapping source-order unions; manual one-question semantic selection; shared/external context and honest unsupported handling; no game/key/failed-ID hints.

prior_findings.evidence: All reserved marker occurrences are parsed and checked against the exact declared begin/end token multiset. Unknown/unselected/dangling/unterminated/malformed/extra/nested cases were rejected.

Valid identified blocks are masked before scanning remaining answer text for complete selected-unit copies. Exact and trimmed unmarked duplicates were rejected while disjoint ID-distinct units with identical text stayed valid.

prior_findings.status: resolved for the declared question/unit/fact/reference ID schemas
prior_findings.evidence: Nontext raw IDs, selected IDs, fact-source IDs, reference IDs and relevant containers produce structured diagnostics. Nontext/duplicate source question IDs and invalid top-level answers containers raise explicit format-review ValueError. No raw input was changed.

independent_synthetic_testing.method: Executed only the authorized checker source in an isolated namespace and called check_data with neutral in-memory source strings/questions/answer objects. No fixtures or real output files were read or written. Every data check compared the synthetic input before/after, and verified diagnostic output does not create a grade/score field or cap.
